app.name: FITD Wii Teste 05.3
app.short_description: Wii GX original ETAGE per-mask occlusion inspector and easy preview toggle
app.long_description: Preliminary PowerPC/GX homebrew technical prototype for the classic Alone in the Dark engine. Experimental AITD1 ETAGE00.PAK room/camera metadata, polygon masks composited over original animated BODY previews in GX. SD logs. NOT the complete game engine. NOT a playable game. Original game files are not included.
